title: Harvest Record Inspection Log
subtitle: Harvest Record: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Harvest Record Inspection Log covers crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff. The harvest operations owner records Harvest Record check times, results, excursions, and review. Harvest Record Inspection Log keeps Harvest Record exceptions visible until the harvest operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Harvest Record Inspection Log at field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location. Document crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff identity before Harvest Record begins. Compare crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff findings with stated Harvest Record criteria; route unresolved Harvest Record issues to farm production reviewer.

sections.title: Monitoring review context and source record
sections.guidance: For Harvest Record, identify responsible parties, field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location, and the linked crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff source.

fields.label: Farm, field, block, crop, and variety
Harvest date, crew, supervisor, and lot
Container, trailer, load, quantity, and destination

sections.title: Repeated checks and recorded results
sections.guidance: Capture Harvest Record facts for crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Field, lot, crew, load, or handoff
Correct, hold, reroute, notify, or none

blocks.label: Harvest Record monitored controls
items: Crew, tool, container, and hygiene readiness
Transport, cooling, receiving, rejection, and loss

sections.title: Excursions, period result, and next review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Harvest Record log excursions; have harvest operations owner record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Harvest Record when lot identity, crop condition, quantity, cooling, or receiving custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Harvest Record proof and route unresolved crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff scope to harvest operations owner.
